asset.label: South Cariboo Community Health Council: two green trees and name, vector reconstruction
asset.sourceLocator: Rebuilt from the one logo image in the council’s Health Plan (cover, a 315 × 141 JPEG; the plan holds no drawing paths), with the black 2000 website emblem and the black-and-grey thank-you lockup as corroboration
asset.dateNote: The Health Plan’s approval date, printed on its cover; not the logo’s adoption.
asset.notes: Two brush-drawn trees, a dark green one and a smaller pale green one behind it to the right, beside “South Cariboo Community Health Council” on four lines in a soft serif.
asset.fidelityNote: A vector reconstruction, not original artwork, which has not been found. The trees are redrawn by hand over a 315 × 141 image, so the brush texture is interpreted, not recovered (no automatic tracing). The pale tree is a linked copy of the dark one at five-sixths scale, on the assumption that the artwork reused one tree; the source’s pale tree looks fuller on the right, so that tree matches it less closely (about 0.66 overlap against 0.89 for the dark tree and the lettering). The earlier, closer-fitted drawing is kept in the research package. The lettering is outlined after ITC Souvenir Demi, the closest typeface tested; the original typeface is not identified. The greens #417A3A and #9BBC95 are sampled from the image, not print specifications.
